title: Metrics/health
implementation: internal/metrics: labeled monotonic counter registry rendering the Prometheus text exposition, no third-party dependencies

internal/app: counters wired at the runtime seams - RSS cycle (per-feed result and per-item outcomes), sync ticks, UNKNOWN confirmation actions, dispatch stage job outcomes and capacity reservation states, startup profile verification decision
cmd/vertex-pro: GET /metrics serves the registry text alongside healthz/readyz; operational counters only, no secrets

checks.bounded_labels: PASS: TestMetricsFamiliesStayBounded runs two scheduler cycles plus a sync tick, pins the expected families/values, and asserts every label key stays within {result,outcome,action,state,decision,profile} with at most 8 labelsets per family
checks.profile_decision: PASS: TestNewEnablesDispatchOnlyFromExactStableVerificationCampaign asserts vertex_profile_verifications_total{decision="VERIFIED",profile="QB_504"} 1 after a full stable campaign
checks.runtime_endpoint: PASS: serve on 127.0.0.1:18091 returned 200 /healthz, 200 /metrics, 401 unauthenticated /api/v1/instances; empty registry renders an empty document before any cycle
checks.full_suite: PASS: go test ./... run twice on 2026-09-06, 96 packages ok, 0 failures

label_cardinality: All label values are fixed sets (outcome enums, reservation state enum, the three known profile IDs, two decision values); instance IDs, feed URLs, and job IDs are deliberately not labels
scope_note: Counters cover the runtime seams named by the playbook (RSS/Add/Sync/capacity/UNKNOWN/Profile). Retention, dashboards, alerting, and diagnostic bundles are OBS-01/03/04 and stage L/M scope.
